intro.summary: Small North Hill community between 4 and 10 Street NW above Crescent Road, almost entirely single-detached homes with downtown views from its south edge.
intro.body: Rosedale sits between 4 Street and 10 Street NW, from 16 Avenue down to Crescent Road, where the bluff looks over downtown and the mountains. Its first homes date from about 1909 and is almost entirely single-detached housing. New builds here are usually one large house replacing an older one.
